source: Scouting and fog of war (see the GDD, 'Scouting and fog of war'). Knowledge of a subject (0 to 100) is the sum of five parts, capped at 'cap': scouts ('scouts.max' shared out by 1 minus the product of what each scout leaves unknown; a scout counts at 'assigned', 'kind' or 'other' of their skill, and a Head of Scouting lifts every scout's skill by a share set in the executive data (up to 25%)), evidence ('perFinal' for each scored final in the last 'seasons' seasons, up to 'max'), visibility ('visibility' times fame), standing (prestige and fame of the player's garage) and experience. An attention flag adds 'attentionFlag'. Below 'rangeFrom' only a word is shown; from 'rangeFrom' a range of whole numbers whose half-width falls from 'widest' to 'narrowest'; from 'exactFrom' the exact value. Potential reads 'potentialPenalty' lower. 'bands' name a value: a word for each, up to its 'max'. 'staff' sets what a scout costs: a year's wage of 'wageBase' plus 'wagePerSkill' for each point of skill, paid in 'roundsPerSeason' parts, 'candidates' on offer at a time and at most 'maxPerGarage' employed; a scout on offer is aged within 'age' and retires at 'retireAge' (checked when the season starts). A computer garage employs scouts under the same rules: none below 'computerFirstAt' prestige, then one at that prestige and one more for every 'computerPer' above it, up to 'maxPerGarage', each paid from the garage's books like an executive. 'inspection' is what a paid inspection of a car for sale costs: 'fee' takes that car to exact while the seller still owns it. 'tips' sets what a Head of Scouting hears first: up to 'max' drivers aged 'maxAge' or younger, not the garage's own, whose potential reads 'minPotential' or more (by the midpoint of the reading the player has, never the truth) and whose results are rising: the average of their last 'form' finals is at least 'minRise' places better than the average of the finals before (public results, so exact). The Head's skill sets how many are heard of: 'max' when their lift reaches 'liftForFull', fewer below it, and at least one. 'capTable' sets how the cap table of a garage the player does not own opens up as their knowledge of that garage grows (see the GDD, 'Ownership and the cap table'): from knowledge 0 only the majority owner (or, with none, the largest holder) and the major owners, those with 'majorFrom' or more of the votes or of the issued shares, are named; from 'owners' every owner is named, with their type and no figures; from 'bands' each owner's stake, votes and asking premium, their asking price and the garage's valuation are read as a band whose half-width follows 'halfWidths' (the entry with the highest 'from' that is reached: points of the whole for a stake, votes and premium, percent of the amount for money); from 'exact' the share counts and every figure are exact. 'step' is the finest a band is drawn to, and a stake, votes or premium band is rounded outward to it.
